result.description:
## ICT Support Technician
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

For nearly 25 years, APD Global has set the benchmark in delivering advanced, comprehensive, and specialised engineering solutions.

We have around 800 employees including our alliance contracting partners, across 15 strategically located offices in Australia (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Darwin), New Zealand and Malaysia. We specialise in seamless integration across the Power Systems, Telecommunications, and Renewable Energy industries. Our expertise spans Power Systems Studies, Transmission Lines, Substations, Telecommunications, Protection, Control & Automation, Renewable Energy Connections, Mining, and Engineering, Protection Panel Design and Installation, 3D Design and Manufacturing as well as Construction/Management (EPC/M) services.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced ACCEPTANCE ENGINEER. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, and NSW.

Role Overview
The Acceptance Engineer works under the direction of the Acceptance Lead to support the successful acceptance, handover, and integration of new and upgraded network assets into Telstra’s operational environment. The role is responsible for ensuring all documentation, as-built records, and asset data are accurate, compliant, and correctly uploaded into Telstra’s DBoR systems in accordance with program and governance requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITY

ACCEPTANCE & HANDOVER
Support the Acceptance Lead in managing the end-to-end acceptance process for Telstra network assets.
Review and validate construction completion packs, ensuring readiness for acceptance and operational handover.
Facilitate the smooth transition of assets from delivery teams into Telstra operational ownership.

DOCUMENTATION & AS-BUILTS
Ensure all project documentation, including as-built drawings, design updates, and asset data, is accurate, complete, and compliant.
Upload and validate as-built information within Telstra’s DBoR systems upon project completion.
Maintain document version control and ensure alignment between physical assets and system records.

DBoR SYSTEM MANAGEMENT
Create, update, and validate asset records using Telstra’s legacy and current DBoR platforms, including: IDEAL, CANRAD, Structure Builder, MITS, RODS, RFNSA, CADlink, Multiman, CRAMER, TPD, WHISPER, TCSS, NETMAPS, WidePlan, Widefeas, CMART, and TRAC.
Resolve data discrepancies and support data quality audits as required by the program.

STAKEHOLDER COORDINATION
Work closely with the Acceptance Lead, internal Telstra teams, delivery partners, and external contractors to coordinate acceptance activities.
Support issue resolution relating to site access, design compliance, documentation gaps, and system data conflicts.
Act as a key interface between construction, design, and operational teams during acceptance and handover.

COMPLIANCE & GOVERNANCE
Ensure all works comply with Telstra design guidelines, relevant Australian Standards, and WHS/safety requirements.
Support program governance by ensuring acceptance processes align with Telstra policies and audit requirements.
Assist with continuous improvement initiatives across acceptance and handover processes.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS
Experience working in network acceptance, handover, or asset management roles within Telstra or similar telecommunications environments.
Strong working knowledge of Telstra DBoR systems and acceptance workflows.
Ability to interpret engineering designs, construction drawings, and as-built documentation.
Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and compliance.

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Work Location: Melbourne, Vic
Salary: $80,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
Engineering Technologist (protection) - Full Time
$80,000-85,000 AUD annually plus superannuation
A.C.N. 656 274 501 PTY LTD T/A Spark Professional Services
Stimson St, Guildford, NSW 2161
ABN 40 656 274 501
About Us:
Spark Professional Services is a leading Australian provider of high and low-voltage electrical engineering solutions, delivering specialised services in testing, commissioning, protection systems, switching, maintenance, and engineering design. With over 15 years of industry expertise, the company supports critical infrastructure projects across data centres, mining, renewable energy, utilities, commercial and industrial facilities, and transport infrastructure sectors.
The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of protection engineering projects including data centre switchgear systems, substations, transmission and distribution networks, and industrial power infrastructure.
Duties and Responsibilities:
1.	Analyse and interpret existing and emerging engineering technologies related to protection philosophies, single-line diagrams, and relay schematics for power system protection. 
2.	Apply technological advancements in the design, configuration, and application of protection relays and schemes. 
3.	Assist engineers in designing and developing protection schemes for electrical systems, including transformers, feeders and generators. 
4.	Configure, program, and set protection relays in accordance with coordination studies. 
5.	Perform protection coordination and grading studies to ensure selectivity and reliability of the protection system. 
6.	Troubleshoot and diagnose protection relay malfunctions, mis-operations, and scheme design issues. 
7.	Recommend modifications and improvements to protection schemes based on technical evaluations and fault analysis. 
8.	Review relay settings and protection schemes for compliance with utility, regulatory, and industry standards. 
9.	Assist in the commissioning and functional testing of protection schemes, ensuring correct relay operation and system integration. 
10.	Collaborate with testing and commissioning technologists, engineers, and technicians to integrate new protection technologies into ongoing projects. 
11.	Identify and investigate protection system failures, trips, and abnormalities, recommending corrective actions. 
12.	Perform periodic reviews and updates of protection settings to reflect system changes and load growth across client networks. 
13.	Ensure protection system designs comply with regulatory requirements, grid codes, and industry standards. 
14.	Monitor and enforce safety measures related to protection system design, settings changes, and implementation. 
15.	Prepare technical reports, protection setting sheets, coordination studies, and documentation for projects and system modifications. 
16.	Maintain accurate records of relay settings, coordination studies, protection scheme changes, and test results. 
Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant industry experience in protection systems, testing, commissioning, or electrical infrastructure projects
•	Knowledge of HV/MV protection systems, protection relay testing, and commissioning practices
•	Familiarity with protection coordination, SCADA integration, and fault diagnosis within electrical networks
•	Experience using engineering and protection software such as ETAP, DigSILENT PowerFactory, or similar systems
•	Understanding of AS/NZS standards, WHS legislation, and electrical safety procedures
•	Strong analytical, technical troubleshooting, and documentation skills
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within project teams
•	Willingness to travel to project sites as required
•	What We Offer
•	Competitive salary package and superannuation
•	Professional development and career progression opportunities
•	Exposure to major infrastructure and electrical engineering projects
•	Supportive and technically focused working environment
